meta_description:
511 likes, 19 comments - ramit on October 17, 2026: "Number 1 is where most people get stuck. 

“I’d start a business, but I don’t have any skills people would pay for.”

Everyone does. Look at what you already pay other people to do: clean your apartment, change your oil, make your dinner. None of that requires a fancy credential. It just requires being good at something someone else doesn’t want to do themselves.

If you’re not sure what yours is, ask your partner or a friend what you’re really good at. They’ll answer faster than you think.

You also don’t have to quit your job to find out if it works. Many of my students started their businesses on the side while working full time.

I started small too. My first product was a $4.95 eBook I sold from my dorm room. It made me some extra spending money. Today it’s a business that makes money while I’m on vacation, out to lunch, or asleep.

Slow and steady wins. Once you believe there are opportunities everywhere, you start seeing them.

Comment CHALLENGE and I’ll send you my free 3-day challenge to find your business idea. You’ll also save your seat for my live session on Monday, Oct 19.".
